basic.description:
{Basic First Aid}

Basic First Aid gives the hero control of the First Aid Tent. The First Aid Tent heals the first unit in a stack for 50 points of Damage and grants all allied creatures +5% Health. The First Aid Tent cannot be dealt more than 40% of its Health as Damage from any single attack.
